'''Muffins''' were a type of small, [[Color/Legends|beige]] [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]]. They could be cooked in an oven.<ref name="Battle for Endor">''[[Ewoks: The Battle for Endor]]''</ref> A muffin variant called [[Muja muffin]]s made from [[Muja fruit]] originated on the [[planet]] [[Gala]]. They were favored by the [[Daan (people)/Legends|Daan]] faction.<ref name="Muja">{{CSWECite|II|341|Muja muffin}}</ref> The [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] served [["Hungry Hutt" breakfast sandwich]]es made with another variant of muffins, [[pedunkee mufkin]]s,<ref name="Dex">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref> prior to its destruction during the first two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]].<ref name="DexEra">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Underworld]]'' states that [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] was destroyed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the novel around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]]. Since ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' states that the Empire was [[Declaration of a New Order|formed]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Dex's Diner was destroyed in either 19 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]] or 18 BBY.</ref> Muffins were often made from the [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] of a [[marble-berry]] [[Plant/Legends|plant]].<ref name="Marble" />

In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Alicka]] was known for her [[blumfruit muffin]]s.<ref name="Trail of the Jedi">''[[Jedi Quest: The Trail of the Jedi]]''</ref>

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], [[Noa Briqualon]] made some muffins in his [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] [[Noa Briqualon's hut|hut]], which were enjoyed by [[Cindel Towani]], [[Teek (Teek)|Teek]] and [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]].<ref name="Battle for Endor" />
